title: Get Presale Tickets to Bon Jovi’s 2027 Forever Tour
summary: Bon Jovi is bringing the Forever Tour to stadiums across North America in 2027, with stops in New Jersey, Chicago, Boston, and Toronto.
body_markdown:
[Bon Jovi](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/bon-jovi-radio) is taking the *Forever Tour* worldwide in 2027 with newly announced stadium shows across North America, the UK, Canada, and Australia.


SiriusXM listeners can access a special presale for select North American dates beginning Thursday, October 29 at 10am local time with code **SiriusXM** .


[Bon Jovi Radio Bon Jovi’s music and more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-BonJoviRadio)


North American fans can also register now at[BonJovi.com](https://www.bonjovi.com/) for access to the artist presale beginning Wednesday, October 28 at 10am local time. Tickets go on sale to the general public Friday, October 30 at 10am local time.


### Bon Jovi 2027 Forever Tour Dates


- Thursday, March 4 — Melbourne, Australia — Marvel Stadium
- Thursday, March 11 — Sydney Olympic Park, Australia — Accor Stadium
- Thursday, June 24 — London, UK — BST Hyde Park
- Thursday, July 15 — East Rutherford, NJ — MetLife Stadium
- Wednesday, July 21 — Chicago, IL — Soldier Field Stadium
- Wednesday, July 28 — Foxborough, MA — Gillette Stadium
- Wednesday, August 4 — Toronto, ON, Canada — Rogers Stadium


The newly announced dates follow Bon Jovi’s return to the stage with sold-out shows across two continents, including nine Madison Square Garden shows, three Wembley Stadium shows, and stadium performances in Edinburgh and Dublin.


“The Forever Tour has been an incredible celebration of the music and the fans who have been with us all these years,” Jon Bon Jovi said. “We’re grateful for every one of you, and now we’re taking that celebration around the world in 2027, with more cities, more countries, and a whole lot more nights to remember.”


### How to Get Bon Jovi Presale Tickets


SiriusXM listeners can access the presale beginning Thursday, October 29 at 10am local time.


**SiriusXM Presale:** Thursday, October 29 from 10 AM–10 PM local time
**Presale code:** SiriusXM
**General on sale:** Friday, October 30 at 10am local time


North American fans can also register at[BonJovi.com](https://www.bonjovi.com/) for access to the artist presale beginning Wednesday, October 28 at 10am local time.


Presale and general on sale dates and times for the UK and Australia vary by market. Visit[BonJovi.com](https://www.bonjovi.com/) for local ticketing details.
